title: Patient Hardship Discount Program Documents: Due Date, Document Age and Extension
content:
**Financial counseling guidance note — Patient Hardship Discount Program.** Documents from the level's list of accepted income documents are due the level's stated number of calendar days after the application date, and may be dated no more than the level's maximum document age before the application date. The documents due date may be extended by the level's extension period, up to the level's maximum number of extensions.

### The three limits

| Limit | Counted from | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Documents due date | The application date | Calendar days after it, as the level sets |
| Document age | The application date | The date printed on a document is no more than the level's maximum age before the application date |
| Extension | The documents due date on file | Each extension adds the level's extension days; no more extensions than the level's maximum per application |

### How the records show it

Each document received is recorded separately with the kind of document and the date printed on it, and the date it was received. An extension of a pending application's documents due date records the new due date and the number of extensions used, counting that extension.

### Worked example (hypothetical application)

An application is dated 2026-04-06 at a level whose documents are due 30 calendar days after the application date, whose one extension adds 14 calendar days, which allows 1 extension per application and which accepts documents up to 90 calendar days old.

- Documents due date: 2026-05-06, which is 30 calendar days after 2026-04-06.
- After the one extension: 2026-05-20, which is 2026-05-06 moved 14 calendar days later. With 1 extension allowed, no further extension is available on that application.
- A pay stub dated 2026-01-06 is 90 calendar days before the application date and meets the age limit.
- A pay stub dated 2026-01-05 is 91 calendar days before the application date and does not.
